## 3. Risk Factors & Favorable Indicators

### ✅ Favorable Indicators
- Young maternal age (31) → Lower aneuploidy rate (~20-25% vs >50% at 40+)

- First IVF cycle → No prior failure history; naive uterine environment
- Optimal lifestyle factors → Active, non-smoker, healthy BMI, low stress
- Normal endometrial thickness
- Day 5 blastocyst → Self-selected developmental competence

### ⚠️ Risk Factors
| Risk | Severity | Comment |
|------|----------|---------|
| 3BB (not AA/AB) | Moderate | Reduced vs top-quality; still transferable |
| TE looseness | Moderate | Loose TE = reduced placentation capacity |
| ICM looseness | Mild-Moderate | Affects embryonic disc formation |
| Male factor (morphology?) | Mild | ICSI mitigates; some DNA fragmentation risk |
| No PGT-A performed | Neutral | ~20-25% aneuploidy risk at age 31 |
| Restricted diet | Low | Potential micronutrient gaps worth screening |
